title: Disentanglement Solution to Orbits puzzle from SiamMandalay®
author: SiamMandalay
review_method: Downloaded 640x480 public reference; inspected frames at 0, 1, 2, 4, 7, 10, 12, 15, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 75, 90, 100, 105, 108 seconds.
identity_note: User described the family as 九连环; this specific set is Orbits with four wooden rings, not a nine-ring Baguenaudier.

observations.description: Title Orbits; four wooden horizontal rings descend along five upright posts on a rectangular wooden base. One top ball and a yellow cord with a wooden pull handle.
Assembled starting condition. The yellow bight surrounds the final short support under the lowest ring, and two cord legs extend toward the wooden handle.
Bight rises through the ring arrangement and passes over the upper ball; cord then traverses successive ring apertures.
Repeated rearrangements move cord loops among the descending rings. This is visual action evidence, not a verified robot or simulation trajectory.
Cord is finally pulled clear and lies beside the complete fixed wooden fixture.

initial_topology.support: ring i is attached at its outer rim to post i+1; taller post i passes through its aperture
initial_topology.ball: on the first, tallest post above the first ring
initial_topology.handle: one wooden terminal handle receiving both cord legs

authored_conventions: Dimensions are authored at tabletop robot scale from image proportions, not measured from the video.
The lower rings must clear the earlier taller posts; ring centers are offset from the enclosed posts.
Two small handle eyes with inserted cord endpoints stand in for the unresolved hidden terminal attachment.
Cord tails are shortened to fit the robot table and arranged clear of the wood; exact pixel poses are not replicated.
Wood finish reuses existing project textures and is not a scan of the reference object.
uncertainties: No measured mass, friction, stiffness, cord length or object dimensions.
Hidden terminal knots and bore construction are not resolved at reference resolution.
Initial state is authored, not gravity settled; all task entities are fixed with collisions disabled.
No dynamic cord solver, self-contact, handle constraints, robot reachability or full solution validated.

product_dimension_reference.unit_note: Product description uses inches; additional information repeats the same numerals with cm. Description inches are used as the approximate reference, not measured dimensions.
product_dimension_reference.scope: Approximate toy-scale match; no measured human-hand or tool-to-hand calibration.

current_scene_scale.reason: User requested 75% of the original geometry, replacing the 35% default.
current_scene_scale.placement_reason: User requested the wooden fixture to be symmetric about the two robot bases on both planar axes; translate +85.5 mm in world Y from v4.
